description: This shell script manages database migrations, resets, status checks, and backups for a sports telecast platform. It includes functions for executing SQL files, creating migration tables, logging migration history, and performing database operations such as dropping tables and backing up data.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Prints a message with a green '[INFO]' label.

methods.name: print_warning
methods.description: Prints a warning message with a yellow '[WARNING]' label.

methods.name: print_error
methods.description: Prints an error message with a red '[ERROR]' label.

methods.name: check_postgres
methods.description: Checks if PostgreSQL is accessible and running.

methods.name: run_sql_file
methods.description: Executes a given SQL file against the database.

methods.name: create_migration_table
methods.description: Creates a migration history tracking table if it does not exist.

methods.name: is_migration_executed
methods.description: Checks if a specific migration has already been executed successfully.

methods.name: record_migration
methods.description: Records the execution status of a migration.

methods.name: run_migrations
methods.description: Orchestrates the execution of pending database migrations.

methods.name: reset_database
methods.description: Drops all tables, functions, and types in the database to reset it.

methods.name: show_status
methods.description: Displays current database status, including table counts and migration history.

methods.name: backup_database
methods.description: Creates a dump backup of the database.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and environment variables.
